# Home Organizers Long Island

> Home Organizers Long Island is a judgment-free professional home organizing service founded by Carolina ("Caro"), its lead organizer. We help busy homeowners declutter, set up simple storage systems and reset full rooms. We serve Long Island, New York City (Brooklyn, Queens and the other boroughs) and anywhere in New York State: Long Island, NYC & beyond.

## Key facts
- Service: hands-on home organizing, decluttering and downsizing, space optimization, full room resets and closet organizing. We also organize digital workspaces for small teams (Slack channels, shared calendars, simple systems).
- Service area: Long Island (Nassau County, Suffolk County, the Hamptons), New York City and the rest of New York State.
- How it works: a free, no-pressure 20-minute consultation, then a clear quote for the project, then the organizing sessions.
- Typical timing: a single closet or pantry usually takes one session of 3 to 5 hours. Garages, basements or full room resets typically take one to three sessions.
- Approach: every decision about what stays and what goes belongs to the client. No need to clean or prepare before the visit.
- Pricing: every home is different, so there is no fixed price list. The quote comes after the free consultation.
- Contact: phone or text (415) 963-2571, email homeorganizerslongisland@gmail.com, or the contact form at https://homeorganizersli.com/#contact
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/homeorganizerslongisland/

## Services
- [Decluttering & downsizing](https://homeorganizersli.com/decluttering-long-island.html): sorting and editing together, at the client's pace.
- [Space optimization](https://homeorganizersli.com/space-optimization-long-island.html): storage systems that fit how the household lives.
- [Full room resets](https://homeorganizersli.com/room-resets-long-island.html): garages, basements, kitchens, home offices and more.
- [Closet organizing](https://homeorganizersli.com/closet-organizing-long-island.html): reach-in and walk-in closets.
- [Garage & holiday decor organizing](https://homeorganizersli.com/garage-organizing-long-island.html): getting decorations out before the holidays, packing them away from late December through January, and a garage set up in zones for the rest of the year.
